web_fixture.content:
# API status & deprecations

Vellmor Instruments, updated 2026-09-08.

All V2 endpoints are stable. The home weather station V1 polling endpoint remains in extended support while stations migrate; its retirement date is published in the deprecation table on this page and is also announced by email to account holders.

web_fixture.title: Release notes - Vellmor Instruments
web_fixture.snippet: Firmware and API release history for Vellmor weather stations; deprecation dates live on the API status page.
web_fixture.content:
# Release notes

Vellmor Instruments.

Station firmware 2.4 improves polling stability after wake-up and fixes a moon-phase display glitch on the console. V2 API additions this quarter: soil moisture ingestion and faster history ranges.

Deprecation and retirement dates are maintained on the API status page; release notes do not carry them.
